**Advanced Computer Architecture (6.0 ECTS)** This module introduces further content in the field of computer architecture, with the following subject areas covered
The focus is on: Complex pipeline features of superscalar and VLIW processors, multi-threading, advanced multi-core and on-chip interconnect concepts,
Accelerator design with high-level synthesis, heterogeneous systems and introduction to
new technologies (neuromorphic computing, in-memory computing).

**Advanced Software Engineering (6.0 ECTS)** Reliability issues in modern software
often result in significant financial losses or system downtime, thereby affecting millions
of users. This course discusses in detail fundamental techniques for ensuring the reliability
of large, complex software systems. Such techniques are heavily used in practice and
range from static program analysis and verification to automated test generation. The
course also focuses on applications of these techniques to different, popular domains,
such as smart contracts and machine-learning models.

**Analog Integrated Circuits (3.0 ECTS)** Mastering analog integrated circuits is also important for many questions in embedded systems and
particularly essential for the design of ICs. This module also teaches
analytical basics for the dimensioning of analog integrated circuits as well
the methods for their modeling.

became mandatory in our digital world. The area of formal methods provides rigorous
